records.text: Dorn Plainstalker guides visitors through tests of faith, endurance and strength, presenting them as trials of spirit, body and mind. He praises those who complete them and welcomes a returning student as stronger and more enlightened. His farewell is warm and personal: “Until we meet again, brave one.”
Synge is a gun merchant who offers goods for browsing. The available interaction also supports ammunition purchases and repairs.
Laer Stepperunner is a food and drink merchant who offers goods for browsing.

A Galak Scout among the centaur forces targeted in the Pacify the Centaur campaign. It attacks with a ranged shot, fitting the role of a skirmisher who can strike from a distance. The quest names Galak Scouts among the groups to be hunted, placing this scout on the hostile side of Freewind Post’s retaliation.

A Galak Mauler in the centaur ranks, using Demoralizing Shout in combat to weaken its opponents. The shout suits a heavy attacker whose presence is meant to wear down resistance as the Galak fight their enemies.

A Galak Windchaser who supports its side in battle with Healing Wave when a friendly creature is badly hurt, while using Enveloping Winds against opponents. This combination makes it a combat healer as well as a spellcaster. The Pacify the Centaur objective names Galak Windchasers among the targets of the campaign.

A Galak Stormer that attacks with Lightning Bolt and, when badly wounded, flees to seek help. Its pattern marks it as an aggressive spellcaster that can call on nearby allies when a fight goes against it.

A Galak Marauder that rushes into combat with a charge as soon as it draws a target’s aggression. It brings direct force to the Galak ranks, relying on momentum to close distance and unsettle an opponent at the start of a fight.

A harpy known for its piercing screech, which it unleashes in combat to deafen its foes. The attack makes sound its defining weapon and marks the creature as a danger to anyone who draws near enough to fight it.
A Screeching Roguefeather is a humanoid combatant found around the local settlements. Its combat ability is Exploit Weakness.
A Screeching Windcaller is a humanoid combatant found around the local settlements. Its combat ability is Gust of Wind.
A Gravelsnout Kobold is a humanoid combatant found around the local settlements. Its combat ability is Strike.
Gravelsnout Vermin are aggressive creatures that inflict infected wounds in combat and may flee for assistance when badly hurt.
Gravelsnout Foragers are hostile creatures whose corrosive acid makes them dangerous in a fight.
Gravelsnout Surveyors are hostile creatures that attack with Frostbolt, bringing a ranged magical threat to encounters.
Cloud Serpents are hostile flying creatures that attack with lightning bolts.
Elder Cloud Serpents are hostile creatures that use lightning bolts in combat; their name marks them as elders among the cloud serpents.
Thundering Boulderkin are creatures of Thousand Needles. Wizlo Bearingshiner’s request identifies them as the source of purifying earth gathered near the western end of the Needles.
Needles Cougars are native to Thousand Needles, appearing across several of its areas.
A Crag Stalker of Thousand Needles.
Silithid Searchers are part of the silithid force in the dig-site area south of Moktar Krin’s position. Moktar asks adventurers to kill them as part of pushing back the swarm.
Silithid Invaders are part of the silithid force at the Thousand Needles dig site. Moktar Krin includes them among the swarm creatures he asks adventurers to kill.
A Silithid Ravager prowls the silithid area of Thousand Needles.

A Silithid Hive Drone is a worker creature of the silithid swarm, found across several Thousand Needles areas. It joins the swarm's defense when badly hurt and is hunted alongside other silithids near the dig site.
A Scorpid Terror prowls the Thousand Needles region. It can unleash a frightening attack when combat begins, making an encounter with this scorpion more dangerous than its name alone suggests.
A Scorpid Reaver is a scorpion found in the Thousand Needles region. It fights with a cleaving attack, a straightforward threat to anyone who engages it.

A Saltstone Basilisk is one of the large animals living on the Shimmering Flats. Trackmaster Zherin warns that the animals can wander onto the race track, and this basilisk can cast Crystalline Slumber in combat.
A Saltstone Gazer is a creature of the Shimmering Flats. It attacks with Crystal Gaze in combat.
A Saltstone Crystalhide is one of the large animals on the Shimmering Flats that Trackmaster Zherin wants culled to keep them from wandering onto the race track. It can use Mana Burn in combat.
A Pesterhide Hyena ranges through the Shimmering Flats and nearby areas. It uses a combat spell when fighting.
A Pesterhide Snarler is a creature found around the Shimmering Flats. It can cast a combat ability when badly hurt.
A Galak Packhound is found in the Shimmering Flats.
Nyse is a wind rider master who handles flight inquiries. When threatened, she calls for the defense of sacred land, reflecting a stated concern for its protection.

Race Master Kronkrider oversees the Shimmering Flats races, announcing starts and celebrating whichever team wins. He welcomes visitors, cautions them about betting, and weighs in on the rivalry: the goblin racer packs a punch, while the gnomes have tricks in their car. His remarks show interest in both teams’ chances, while his role centers on keeping the race crowd informed.

The Goblin Pit Crewman works on the race car, discussing its bones and modifications and warning that added speed may come at the cost of durability in collisions. He backs the goblin team, praises its tools and talent, and urges visitors to support it, while expressing irritation at the gnomes’ luck. His pit-side expertise is practical: he can strengthen the car, but expects it may not withstand much bumping.

A gnome member of the Mirage Raceway pit crew, this tinkerer takes pride in the team's ingenuity and boasts that its car outclasses the goblins' machine. He says he has upgraded the car and predicts a decisive win, reflecting the crews' rivalry and his confidence in gnomish engineering.

Kravel Koalbeard makes money supplying race crews with parts and other special orders, and sees profit even in the wreckage of crashes. He is opportunistic and calculating: he skims a piece from a customer's order, cultivates wealthy customers such as Hemet Nesingwary Jr., and pitches risky schemes to Crank Fizzlebub for their mutual profit. He also handles confidential information cautiously when it may be too dangerous to exploit himself.

Wizzle Brassbolts works on the rocket car alongside his brother Fizzle. He worries that Fizzle’s powerful new fuel could eat through the chassis, so he is developing hard, corrosion-resistant composite and tortoise-shell fuel tanks. He also seeks Gahz'rilla’s crackling scale to harness its energy for the car.

Fizzle Brassbolts is an exuberant, experimental engineer whose many designs aim to make the brothers’ rocket car fly. He is testing a very hot fuel made with salty scorpid venom and developing a high-speed engine, but repeated attempts at durable pistons have failed. He turns to the smith Martek for help and eagerly asks what he learned.

Moktar Krin leads a war party in Thousand Needles, badly weakened after an insect attack at the dwarven dig site. He holds position while awaiting word from Belgrom and asks travelers to help push back the silithids. His crude joke about the ichor marks a blunt, wry manner.
The Gnome Pit Boss leads the gnome pit crew at Mirage Raceway. When offered Fool's Stout, he calls it considerate, then wonders whether a little for his crew is harmless despite the upcoming race.
The Goblin Pit Boss leads the goblin pit crew at Mirage Raceway. When offered Fool's Stout, he shows interest and says he does not mind having a little.

Rok'Alim the Pounder is an unusually powerful elemental who remained in Azeroth after most elementals faded when the Old Gods were banished. Dorn Plainstalker's strength test places him in Thousand Needles and presents defeating him as a test of strength.
Daisy is the Race Starter Girl at the race venue.
Nag'zehn is a humanoid in Thousand Needles.
Bor'zehn is a humanoid in Thousand Needles.
Tarkreu Shadowstalker is a humanoid in Thousand Needles.
Steelsnap is a hyena who roams Thousand Needles. Melor Stonehoof's quest text portrays him as a tyrant who draws other hyenas to him and spreads fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.
Fobeed is the race announcer. He calls the start, invites spectators to bet on the goblin car before a race, and urges them to bet on the gnomes for the next one.

Trackmaster Zherin was hired after a racer crashed with a basilisk to keep the Shimmering Flats course clear and safe. He worries that the region’s large basilisks may wander onto the track during races; afterward, he is left clearing wreckage and burnt animal remains. He asks for help thinning the basilisk population while warning against leaving carcasses on the course, where the sun does little to speed their decay.

Pozzik leads the Shimmering Flats racing crew’s engineering work, seeking small improvements to racer speed, strength, and weight. He uses vulture bones for lighter structural parts and wants indurium to strengthen other components so his team can keep pace with the gnomes. He is also investigating the Brassbolts brothers’ unexplained speed gains and targets Rizzle’s plans for the new material. His focus is practical: gather materials, improve the cars, and prepare for the next race.

Razzeric is the Shimmering Flats racing team's eighteenth pilot, known for daring modifications to Pozzik's racers. He loosens their controls, strips away frame parts, and wants more power; his project to fit a seaforium booster shows how far he is willing to push a racer. He once worked around the pit helping mechanics before becoming the team's pilot.
Zuzubee is identified as the Race Announcer at the Shimmering Flats raceway.
Zamek is involved in creating a diversion on behalf of the Shimmering Flats racing rivalry. During the scheme, he exclaims, “Hehehe! Things go boom!”

Rizzle Brassbolts is focused on plans for a new building material tied to the Brassbolts racers' improved speed. When startled, he suspects the goblins caused the disturbance and goes to inspect the damage; once he sees there is nothing more to be done, he sounds frustrated.

At Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner studies the centaurs and their Cloven Hoof relic. He explains that moonwell water can weaken the eternal flame protecting it; after receiving the Hoof, he is eager to investigate its strange energy and learn what it may reveal about centaur ancestry.
Turhaw is Freewind Post’s butcher, supplying provisions and goods for travelers.
Jawn Highmesa supplies general goods and ammunition at Freewind Post.
Jandia deals in trade supplies.
Montarr is Freewind Post’s lorekeeper and offers reagents among his goods.
A goblin drag car, a mechanical vehicle in Thousand Needles.
A gnome drag car, a mechanical vehicle in Thousand Needles.
A kodo associated with a war party.
Drag Master Miglen is a drag master in Thousand Needles.
Prate Cloudseer guides a shaman through the air totem rite. The totem represents proof of readiness; she can offer a totem for focusing spells and invite further training.

Achellios the Banished is a named figure in Thousand Needles. It may carry the Pendant of Myzrael, an item that starts “Crystal in the Mountains,” with a plea and a vision of a crystal in the northern mountains.
Heartrazor is a rare beast that casts a spell during combat.
Ironeye the Invincible is a elite creature. When wounded, it can cast a spell as part of its combat behavior.
Vile Sting is a creature encountered in the Thousand Needles region.
Highperch Soarers are creatures found in the area.
Riznek is a drink vendor who offers goods for browsing.
Brivelthwerp is an ice cream vendor who offers goods for browsing.

Magus Tirth was once a respected mage and scholar, but gambling has left him in trouble: he sold his copy of Rituals of Power to pay debts. He needs his missing apprentice to recall the phrase for his locked strongbox. Tirth admits he cursed Johnson, though he has forgotten why.
A curse has left “Plucky” Johnson in chicken form. Beckon draws him toward the player and restores his human form; he can then offer the “Get the Scoop” interaction.
Jinky Twizzlefixxit is an engineering-supplies vendor. She offers goods to browse and has a questgiver interaction.
Galak Flame Guard is identified by its guard title and Galak name.

At the Shimmering Flats racetrack, Quentin investigates whether Thousand Needles’ damaged land can be renewed, hoping to find a nearby water source. He also helps assess a sprite darter egg and prepares a spell to protect it, mindful of the poachers that have threatened these creatures.
Swirling Vortex is an elemental creature that casts a spell in combat.
A Freewind Brave in Thousand Needles.
Starn is a gunsmith and bowyer in Freewind Post, offering goods through his merchant services.

Brave Moonhorn warns that centaur attacks have increased and urges Freewind Post to learn of the renewed harassment. He asks a traveler to carry an urgent message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn and cautions that the nearby Grimtotem Clan has been acting strangely toward his people.

Elu is a wind rider apprentice in Freewind Post, tasked with recruiting wyverns for the master wind riders. She hopes to become a wind rider herself and seeks wyvern eggs from Highperch to advance her training, warning that the nesting wyverns defend their eggs.

Pao'ka Swiftmountain went to Highperch to study wyverns, but was chased from a nest and became lost. He fears Motega Firemane will be furious that he went alone, and asks for help reaching Whitereach Post. Once the route looks familiar, Pao'ka says he can find his way back and asks that Motega be persuaded not to send him home.

Motega Firemane is a Tauren at Whitereach Post who takes Hagar Lightninghoof’s report of Arikara’s return as an urgent threat. He works with Magatha Grimtotem’s sacred-fire plan, yet is unsettled by the claim that Arikara may be pursuing Cairne Bloodhoof and questions how that fits with Magatha’s judgment. He treats the danger as serious and asks for the serpent’s defeat.

Cliffwatcher Longhorn is a Tauren at Freewind Post who calls for force against the Galak centaurs threatening the area. He also suspects the Grimtotem Clan is conducting a secret operation at Darkcloud Pinnacle and entrusts an investigator with finding out more. In a separate concern, he asks that a report about unusual centaur activity be delivered to his brother Nataka, stationed at Ghost Walker Post.

Hagar Lightninghoof is a Tauren at Freewind Post with a strong curiosity about the strange egg reported in nearby serpent dens. He asks for it to be brought to him so he can examine it, and his reaction on receiving it shows that its contents surprise him. When he learns of Arikara’s return, he urges the hearer to take the news to Motega Firemane, whom he believes will know what to do.
A dog identified by the subname “Sire.”
Guard Wachabe serves as a guard in Thousand Needles.
Galak Messenger is a messenger in Thousand Needles associated with the Assassination Note, which starts “Assassination Plot.” That quest concerns warning Kanati Greycloud about a plot against him.

A Tauren at Whitereach Post whose hunting camp in Thousand Needles has drawn a centaur assassination plot. When warned, Kanati meets the threat with defiance and calls for help defending the post; he later thanks those who helped hold off the attackers.

Thalia Amberhide worries for Lakota Windsong and welcomes her return from Arnak’s kidnapping. After Lakota escapes, Thalia praises her rescuer’s bravery and gives the player belongings of Lakota’s slain brother, trusting that Lakota would want them passed on.

Lakota Windsong refused Arnak’s marriage offer; he later kidnapped her and killed her brother when he tried to stop him. During her escape, Lakota warns that Arnak has a strange power over the Grimtotem and expects their hostility. At the end of the escort, she says she can return to Freewind Post on her own.
An elemental creature found in Dustwallow Marsh. It casts a spell when wounded.
An elemental creature found in Dustwallow Marsh. It casts a spell when wounded.
A Grimtotem bandit, a humanoid combatant in Dustwallow Marsh. Its combat behavior includes casting a spell.
A Grimtotem stomper, a humanoid combatant in Dustwallow Marsh. It uses spells during combat, including one when wounded.
A Grimtotem geomancer, a humanoid combatant in Dustwallow Marsh. It casts a spell during combat.
A Grimtotem reaver, a humanoid combatant found in Dustwallow Marsh.
Arnak Grimtotem is a Grimtotem outcast accused of murder and kidnapping, and the subject of a wanted notice.

Wizlo Bearingshiner is a stranded tinkerer, the sole survivor of a centaur attack on his caravan. He arranges unusual jobs for clients, including setting up a concealed console to operate a Robotron near Thalanaar. He admits this helped a client steal water from a moonwell, but says he takes the work because the client pays.
An enraged panther that can be passive and non-attackable.
Innkeeper Abeqwa welcomes visitors with the greeting, “As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.” Guests can make the inn their home and browse his goods.
Awenasa is a stable master who helps visitors care for their pets. Her service includes arranging pet stabling and assisting with lost companions.

Grish Longrunner guards the Great Lift in the southern Barrens and has been waiting for relief long enough to complain about it. He looks forward to spending time with his family once a reserve warrior arrives.
Harb Foulmountain is a rare humanoid who uses Thrash in combat.
Gibblesnik is a rare humanoid who attacks with a spell in combat.
Elder Skyseer reflects on a time when people hunted for glory and honor, then wonders whether the present is really so different. Elder Skyseer accepts homage and offers a token in return.

Elder Morningdew sees the stars as beacons of hope and strength for the ages ahead. Morningdew believes they hold answers to earthly mysteries, inviting the wise and fortunate to look upward in search of truth.

Magistrix Elosai is a Sin'dorei researcher in Thousand Needles, estranged from her people after they rejected and burned her treatise on natural cures for magical addiction. She pursues that research with help from Wizlo Bearingshiner, testing a tonic intended to lessen her people's addiction.
Robotron 3000 is a mechanical in Thousand Needles.
The Thousand Needles Flame Keeper is a humanoid festival attendant associated with honoring the local flame.

place_records.text: You are in Thousand Needles, a contested zone of Kalimdor where both sides hold ground. Freewind Post is Horde land, and the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats is held by the Alliance. Galak centaur raiders prowl the crags, scorpids and basilisks roam the salt flats, cloud serpents lurk along the cliffs, and silithids swarm around the Rustmaul dig site.

You are in The Shimmering Flats, a stretch of salt flats in Thousand Needles. Racers run a course across it, and the large basilisks here are feared to wander onto the track during races. Scorpid reavers and scorpid terrors stalk the flats, with saltstone basilisks, crystalhides, gazers and scavengers roaming beside them.

You are in The Rustmaul Dig Site, a dig in Thousand Needles overrun by silithids. Silithid searchers, invaders and ravagers swarm over the diggings, and hive drones of the same swarm are found across several areas of Thousand Needles.
You are in Camp E'thok, a Galak centaur camp in Thousand Needles. Galak stormers, maulers and marauders are its main danger, with pesterhide snarlers and cougars prowling nearby.

You are in Splithoof Crag, the stronghold of the Galak centaurs in Thousand Needles. Galak windchasers, wranglers and scouts roam the crag, with maulers, stormers and marauders beside them. A flame guards a relic in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.

You are in Highperch, a wyvern haunt in Thousand Needles. Highperch wyverns, consorts and patriarchs nest here, and a heartrazor is known to prowl. A Horde researcher, Pao'ka Swiftmountain, is lost here after wyverns chased him from a nest.

You are in The Screeching Canyon, a canyon in Thousand Needles. Screeching harpies, roguefeathers and windcallers haunt it, and pesterhide hyenas, cougars and gravelsnout foragers prowl alongside them.

You are in Freewind Post, a Horde post in Thousand Needles with a flight master, an inn and a stable. Cliffwatcher Longhorn, a tauren, calls for force against the Galak centaurs threatening the area. Elu, a wind rider apprentice, recruits wyverns for the master wind riders, and Hagar Lightninghoof is curious about a strange egg reported in nearby serpent dens.

You are in The Great Lift, a lift in Thousand Needles. Horde guard Grish Longrunner keeps watch over it. Brave Moonhorn warns that centaur attacks have increased and that the nearby Grimtotem Clan has been acting strangely.

You are in Darkcloud Pinnacle, a Grimtotem-held pinnacle in Thousand Needles. Grimtotem stompers, geomancers, reavers and bandits roam it, along with boiling elementals. Lakota Windsong, a Horde woman, was kidnapped here by Arnak, and during her escape she warned that he has a strange power over the Grimtotem.

You are in Whitereach Post, a Horde post in Thousand Needles with a vendor. Motega Firemane, a tauren, takes the return of Arikara as an urgent threat, and Kanati Greycloud calls for help defending the post against centaur assassins. Wizlo Bearingshiner, a stranded tinkerer who survived a centaur attack on his caravan, arranges unusual jobs for clients.

You are in Mirage Raceway, the Alliance-held racetrack on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. Pozzik leads the racing crew's engineering, and the Brassbolts brothers build a rocket car there, with Fizzle testing a very hot fuel. Trackmaster Zherin is left clearing wreckage after crashes, and scorpids and basilisks threaten the course.

You are in Windbreak Canyon, a canyon in Thousand Needles with Horde teachers. Dorn Plainstalker leads visitors through trials of spirit, body and mind, and Prate Cloudseer guides shamans through the air totem rite. Elder cloud serpents, cougars and pesterhide snarlers roam the canyon.

You are in Ironstone Camp, a Horde war camp in Thousand Needles. Moktar Krin leads its war party, which is badly weakened after silithids attacked the dwarven dig site to the south. Silithids remain a threat to the camp, and Moktar Krin is still waiting on word from Belgrom.
You are in Tahonda Ruins, in Thousand Needles. Saltstone crystalhides and gazers haunt the ruins, and Salt Flats vultures are found here too.
